<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_cmdbgov_app.CMDBGovDataSource</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Read-only data access: local GlideRecord/GlideAggregate or a remote instance over REST (Basic or OAuth 2.0).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CMDBGovDataSource</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/**
 * CMDBGovDataSource
 * Read-only data access for the CMDB Governance engine.
 *
 *  - "local"  mode reads this instance with GlideRecord / GlideAggregate.
 *  - "remote" mode reads another instance through the REST Table API and
 *             Aggregate (stats) API, authenticating with either a
 *             Basic Auth profile or an OAuth 2.0 profile.
 *
 * Every method is read-only. Nothing is ever written to the CMDB.
 *
 * Scope: x_cmdbgov_app   Access: This application scope only
 */
var CMDBGovDataSource = Class.create();

CMDBGovDataSource.prototype = {

    /**
     * @param {Object} config  result of new CMDBGovConfig().get()
     */
    initialize: function(config) {
        this.cfg = config || new CMDBGovConfig().get();
        this.mode = this.cfg.dataSource;
        this._tableCache = {};
        this._fieldCache = {};
        this._labelCache = {};
        if (this.mode === 'remote') {
            if (!this.cfg.remoteUrl)
                throw new Error('Remote mode is selected but x_cmdbgov_app.remote.instance_url is empty.');
            if (!this.cfg.authProfile)
                throw new Error('Remote mode is selected but x_cmdbgov_app.remote.auth_profile is empty.');
        }
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Public API                                                         */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    describe: function() {
        return {
            mode: this.mode,
            instance: this.instanceUrl(),
            authType: this.mode === 'remote' ? this.cfg.authType : 'session'
        };
    },

    /** Base URL used to build "open in ServiceNow" links. Always ends with "/". */
    instanceUrl: function() {
        if (this.mode === 'remote')
            return this.cfg.remoteUrl + '/';
        var uri = gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri', '/');
        return uri.charAt(uri.length - 1) === '/' ? uri : uri + '/';
    },

    tableExists: function(table) {
        if (this._tableCache.hasOwnProperty(table))
            return this._tableCache[table];
        var exists = this.mode === 'remote' ? this._remoteTableExists(table) : this._localTableExists(table);
        this._tableCache[table] = exists;
        return exists;
    },

    fieldExists: function(table, field) {
        var key = table + '.' + field;
        if (this._fieldCache.hasOwnProperty(key))
            return this._fieldCache[key];
        var exists = false;
        if (this.tableExists(table))
            exists = this.mode === 'remote' ? this._remoteFieldExists(table, field) : this._localFieldExists(table, field);
        this._fieldCache[key] = exists;
        return exists;
    },

    tableLabel: function(table) {
        if (this._labelCache.hasOwnProperty(table))
            return this._labelCache[table];
        var label = table;
        try {
            label = this.mode === 'remote' ? this._remoteTableLabel(table) : this._localTableLabel(table);
        } catch (e) {
            label = table;
        }
        this._labelCache[table] = label || table;
        return this._labelCache[table];
    },

    /** Number of records matching an encoded query. */
    count: function(table, query) {
        return this.mode === 'remote' ? this._remoteCount(table, query) : this._localCount(table, query);
    },

    /**
     * Group records by a field and return groups whose count is >= minCount.
     * @returns {Array} [{value, display, count}] sorted by count descending
     */
    groupCount: function(table, field, query, minCount, limit) {
        var rows = this.mode === 'remote'
            ? this._remoteGroupCount(table, field, query, minCount, limit)
            : this._localGroupCount(table, field, query, minCount, limit);
        rows.sort(function(a, b) { return b.count - a.count; });
        return rows;
    },

    /**
     * List records.
     * @returns {Array} [{sys_id, <field>: {value, display}}]
     */
    list: function(table, query, fields, limit, orderByDesc) {
        return this.mode === 'remote'
            ? this._remoteList(table, query, fields, limit, orderByDesc)
            : this._localList(table, query, fields, limit, orderByDesc);
    },

    /** Encoded query date literal (UTC, system format) for N days ago. */
    daysAgo: function(days) {
        var gdt = new GlideDateTime();
        gdt.addDaysUTC(-days);
        return gdt.getValue();
    },

    /** Current date/time literal (UTC, system format). */
    now: function() {
        return new GlideDateTime().getValue();
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Local implementation (GlideRecord / GlideAggregate)                */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    _localTableExists: function(table) {
        try {
            return new GlideRecord(table).isValid();
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    },

    _localFieldExists: function(table, field) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
            return gr.isValid() && gr.isValidField(field);
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    },

    _localTableLabel: function(table) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        return gr.isValid() ? gr.getClassDisplayValue() : table;
    },

    _localCount: function(table, query) {
        var ga = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (query)
            ga.addEncodedQuery(query);
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();
        return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0 : 0;
    },

    _localGroupCount: function(table, field, query, minCount, limit) {
        var ga = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (query)
            ga.addEncodedQuery(query);
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT', field);
        ga.groupBy(field);
        if (minCount && minCount > 1)
            ga.addHaving('COUNT', '>', String(minCount - 1));
        ga.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (ga.next() && rows.length < (limit || 500)) {
            rows.push({
                value: ga.getValue(field),
                display: ga.getDisplayValue(field) || ga.getValue(field),
                count: parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT', field), 10) || 0
            });
        }
        return rows;
    },

    _localList: function(table, query, fields, limit, orderByDesc) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        if (query)
            gr.addEncodedQuery(query);
        if (orderByDesc)
            gr.orderByDesc(orderByDesc);
        gr.setLimit(limit || 100);
        gr.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            var row = { sys_id: gr.getUniqueValue() };
            for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
                var f = fields[i];
                if (f === 'sys_id' || !gr.isValidField(f))
                    continue;
                row[f] = { value: gr.getValue(f) || '', display: gr.getDisplayValue(f) || '' };
            }
            rows.push(row);
        }
        return rows;
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Remote implementation (REST Table API + Aggregate API)             */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    _rest: function(path, params, allowFailure) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        r.setHttpMethod('get');
        r.setEndpoint(this.cfg.remoteUrl + path);
        r.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        r.setAuthenticationProfile(this.cfg.authType, this.cfg.authProfile);
        r.setHttpTimeout(120000);
        for (var k in params) {
            if (params.hasOwnProperty(k) && params[k] !== undefined && params[k] !== null && params[k] !== '')
                r.setQueryParameter(k, String(params[k]));
        }
        var resp = r.execute();
        var code = resp.getStatusCode();
        if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
            if (allowFailure)
                return null;
            var body = String(resp.getBody() || resp.getErrorMessage() || '');
            throw new Error('Remote instance returned HTTP ' + code + ' for ' + path + ': ' + body.substring(0, 300));
        }
        return JSON.parse(resp.getBody());
    },

    _remoteTableExists: function(table) {
        var res = this._rest('/api/now/table/' + table, { sysparm_limit: 1, sysparm_fields: 'sys_id' }, true);
        return res !== null;
    },

    _remoteFieldExists: function(table, field) {
        var sampleKey = '__sample__' + table;
        if (!this._fieldCache.hasOwnProperty(sampleKey)) {
            var res = this._rest('/api/now/table/' + table, { sysparm_limit: 1, sysparm_exclude_reference_link: 'true' }, true);
            this._fieldCache[sampleKey] = (res && res.result && res.result.length) ? res.result[0] : null;
        }
        var sample = this._fieldCache[sampleKey];
        // No records to inspect: treat as present; queries against an empty table return 0 anyway.
        return sample === null ? true : sample.hasOwnProperty(field);
    },

    _remoteTableLabel: function(table) {
        var res = this._rest('/api/now/table/sys_db_object', {
            sysparm_query: 'name=' + table,
            sysparm_fields: 'label',
            sysparm_limit: 1
        }, true);
        return (res && res.result && res.result.length) ? res.result[0].label : table;
    },

    _remoteCount: function(table, query) {
        var res = this._rest('/api/now/stats/' + table, { sysparm_count: 'true', sysparm_query: query || '' });
        return parseInt(res.result.stats.count, 10) || 0;
    },

    _remoteGroupCount: function(table, field, query, minCount, limit) {
        var params = {
            sysparm_count: 'true',
            sysparm_query: query || '',
            sysparm_group_by: field,
            sysparm_display_value: 'all'
        };
        if (minCount && minCount > 1)
            params.sysparm_having = 'count^' + field + '^>^' + (minCount - 1);
        var res = this._rest('/api/now/stats/' + table, params);
        var groups = res.result || [];
        if (!(groups instanceof Array))
            groups = [groups];
        var rows = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < groups.length && rows.length < (limit || 500); i++) {
            var g = groups[i];
            var gf = (g.groupby_fields && g.groupby_fields.length) ? g.groupby_fields[0] : {};
            rows.push({
                value: gf.value || '',
                display: gf.display_value || gf.value || '',
                count: parseInt(g.stats.count, 10) || 0
            });
        }
        return rows;
    },

    _remoteList: function(table, query, fields, limit, orderByDesc) {
        var q = query || '';
        if (orderByDesc)
            q += (q ? '^' : '') + 'ORDERBYDESC' + orderByDesc;
        var res = this._rest('/api/now/table/' + table, {
            sysparm_query: q,
            sysparm_fields: ['sys_id'].concat(fields).join(','),
            sysparm_limit: limit || 100,
            sysparm_display_value: 'all',
            sysparm_exclude_reference_link: 'true'
        });
        var rows = [];
        var result = res.result || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
            var rec = result[i];
            var sid = rec.sys_id;
            var row = { sys_id: (sid && typeof sid === 'object') ? sid.value : sid };
            for (var j = 0; j < fields.length; j++) {
                var f = fields[j];
                if (f === 'sys_id' || !rec.hasOwnProperty(f))
                    continue;
                var v = rec[f];
                if (v && typeof v === 'object')
                    row[f] = { value: v.value || '', display: v.display_value || v.value || '' };
                else
                    row[f] = { value: v || '', display: v || '' };
            }
            rows.push(row);
        }
        return rows;
    },

    type: 'CMDBGovDataSource'
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 04:54:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>863962a0e3685fe294ae6a76d69c976e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-18 04:54:05</sys_updated_on><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_863962a0e3685fe294ae6a76d69c976e</sys_update_name><sys_package display_value="CMDB Governance" source="x_cmdbgov_app">1a9f4ea4623358e6ab416ae78953397e</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="CMDB Governance">1a9f4ea4623358e6ab416ae78953397e</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>
